title: backlog.py new bug refuses a repro whose program check refuses
goal: Retrospective of SP-qxcj7fgy: ST-7avb5uo6's worker filed BG-77i2lwmr with a grep repro; new accepted it, the worker's backlog.py check ran before the filing, and land stopped at the sync gate (backlog.py check errors=1, and three test_land_e2e tests that copy the backlog) until the orchestrator rewrote the repro on the branch. new bug, set --repro and set --check refuse a program that bl_intake.check_program_refusal refuses, with exit 2 and nothing written, so a worker's filed bug never fails the landing gate.

run: import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile; t=tempfile.mkdtemp(); os.makedirs(t+"/_backlog"); p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","--root",t,"new","bug","--title","b","--severity","S3","--goal","g","--repro","grep -q zzzzqqqq _tools/backlog.py","--repro-reason","the defect is a docstring line"],capture_output=True,text=True); sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==2 and os.listdir(t+"/_backlog")==[] else 1)

notes: SP-4phd36pa close (2026-10-11): new bug accepted four parked review bugs' sh -c repros (BG-az4r47gd and three others); backlog.py check then refused them (bl_intake.check_program_refusal) and the review story's done refused once. Merged from BG-asbzy5z4 “new crashes with a shlex traceback on a --repro or --check command with an unclosed quote instead of a usage error” at the 2026-10-12 draft triage: repro run: new --repro "echo it's" still ends in a shlex ValueError traceback; same bl_items.parse_cmd path as ST-webfvbcb, which must validate the argv anyway Its goal: backlog.py new with a --repro or --check value whose command has an unclosed quote (such as an apostrophe in a word) exits 2 with a usage error naming the option, and writes no item, instead of a ValueError traceback from shlex.split in bl_items.parse_cmd; set already does this. Found while fixing BG-4iaxny3s. Its repro: {"run": ["python3", "-c", "import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile; t=tempfile.mkdtemp(); os.makedirs(t+\"/_backlog\"); p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,\"_tools/backlog.py\",\"--root\",t,\"new\",\"bug\",\"--title\",\"t\",\"--severity\",\"S3\",\"--goal\",\"g\",\"--repro\",\"echo it\"+chr(39)+\"s\"],capture_output=True,text=True); sys.exit(1 if \"Traceback\" in p.stderr or p.returncode != 2 else 0)"]} Merged from ST-btfulaeh “backlog.py new refuses a repro or check that backlog check would refuse, such as python3 -I” at the 2026-10-12 draft triage: same defect as ST-webfvbcb: new/set accept python3 -I -c, check_program_refusal returns '-I is not a _tools/ script'; filed by SP-ceucrhca as a recurrence Its goal: backlog.py new and set refuse, with the same reason, a repro or check argv that bl_intake.check_program_refusal refuses, so a worker's filed bug cannot pass its own commit and stop the landing's sync gate Its checks: {"run": ["python3", "_tools/tests.py", "-k", "new_refuses_refused_repro"]}
